question: Which Indian reformer is regarded as the "Father of Bengali Prose"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar was a renowned Bengali polymath and social reformer who lived during the 19th century.**
 
• He is credited with modernizing and standardizing the** Bengali language **and making it accessible to the masses through his literary works.
